giftGiftSettingsForm.autoIssueLabel: Create the code automatically upon payment
giftGiftSettingsForm.autoIssueHelp: When a customer pays for an order containing a gift certificate, the code is created automatically: it appears in the «Gift certificates» section and is shown to the customer after checkout. If disabled, the code has to be issued manually from the order card.
giftGiftSettingsForm.validDaysLabel: How many days the code is valid
giftGiftSettingsForm.validDaysHelp: Leave the field empty and the code never expires. The term is counted from the day the code is issued.
giftGiftSettingsForm.categoriesHelp1: Section addresses as they appear in the site link (the part after /catalog/). Separate them with commas or new lines. At checkout, products from these sections are flagged in the order itself as gift certificates, and the code is later created based on that flag. Already placed orders are not affected: even if you rename or delete a section, the code will still be issued because the flag is stored in the order.
giftGiftSettingsForm.categoriesHelp2: If you leave the field empty, nothing is flagged by section. Codes will still be created for products whose gift-certificate flag is set on the product card itself. The only way to disable code issuance entirely is the «Create the code automatically upon payment» checkbox above.
giftGiftSettingsForm.allowIssueLabel: Create the code even when the order is paid with another certificate
giftGiftSettingsForm.allowIssueHelp: A customer can pay for a new certificate with the balance of an old one — effectively exchanging its value. Disable this if your store does not allow such exchanges.

errors.validDaysNotInteger: The validity period is a whole number of days (0 or empty — unlimited).
errors.validDaysTooLarge: The validity period is too large — enter a reasonable number of days.

currencyUnitsForm.refreshSuccess: Rates updated from the Central Bank of Russia. Currencies with a manual rate were left untouched.
currencyUnitsForm.baseCurrencyCodeHelp: The currency used for storage and payment. Three Latin letters: RUB — ruble, USD — dollar, EUR — euro.
currencyUnitsForm.numberFormatHelp: How to separate digit groups and the decimal part. ru-RU — the convention used in Russia.
currencyUnitsForm.additionalCurrenciesTitle: Additional currencies (display only, by exchange rate)
currencyUnitsForm.additionalCurrenciesHelp: Prices are stored and payment is taken in the base currency. Here are the currencies for the storefront switcher. The rate is how many base units equal 1 unit of this currency (e.g. 100 → 1 € = 100 ₽; the price is shown as price ₽ / rate).
currencyUnitsForm.autoRateLabel: Update the rate automatically from the Central Bank of Russia (otherwise the manually entered rate below is used)
currencyUnitsForm.manualRateLabel: Rate set manually — automatic updates from the Central Bank do not affect this currency
currencyUnitsForm.refreshRatesButton: Update rates from the Central Bank now
currencyUnitsForm.refreshRatesHelp: The update button is handy right after unchecking «rate set manually» — the rate will be fetched without waiting for the nightly update.

languagesForm.storefrontNoticeTitle: How this set affects the site.
languagesForm.storefrontNoticeBody: The set takes effect in two places at once. On the site: enabled languages appear in the language switcher, while a disabled language is removed from the site — its addresses redirect to the default language ({defaultLabel}). In the admin panel: the set determines the translation tabs in the catalog and content forms.
languagesForm.storefrontSupportHint: Any shop may add a language to the set, but the site can only display it once the interface has been translated into that language. A language without a translation will not appear on the site: its pages redirect to the default language, even though the translation tabs in the admin panel start working right away. If you need the new language on the site itself, ask the developers to add the interface translation.
languagesForm.defaultLocaleHelp: Cannot be changed. All primary content (names, descriptions, page texts) is stored in the database in this language, with translations layered on top. Changing the default language would require migrating all data and would change the site's page URLs, so it is done separately, by hand.
languagesForm.customHelp: Standard language code: two or three Latin letters, optionally with a region after a hyphen.

orderActionsPanel.heading: Status management
orderActionsPanel.intro: Order, payment and delivery statuses are managed independently.
orderActionsPanel.confirmCancel: Cancel the order? The stock reservation will be released. This action does NOT refund money: for a paid order use «Refund».
orderActionsPanel.confirmRefund: Issue a refund? The system will call the payment gateway to return the money to the customer, release the reservation and revoke gift codes issued for this order.
orderActionsPanel.forceTitle: Stock for this line is unavailable
orderActionsPanel.forceHint: The reservation could not be written off — for example, the product variant was deleted from the catalogue together with its stock row. Retrying will fail every time. You can ship the order without writing off stock: the affected SKUs go into the order history and the audit log, and their stock has to be corrected manually.
orderActionsPanel.forceCommentRequired: Add a comment explaining why — it goes into the order history.
orderActionsPanel.confirmForce: Ship without writing off stock? Stock for these lines will have to be corrected manually.
orderActionsPanel.confirmManualRefund: Confirm that the money has already been returned to the customer OUTSIDE the system (bank transfer/cash desk)? The order will be marked refunded and your confirmation will be written to the audit log.
orderActionsPanel.manualRefundTitle: The gateway will not refund automatically
orderActionsPanel.manualRefundHint: For this order the payment gateway does not perform refunds (for example, an offline payment or an acquirer without automatic refunds). Return the money to the customer yourself — by transfer or from the cash desk — and only then confirm. The confirmation is recorded in the audit log.
orderActionsPanel.manualRefundButton: Money returned outside the system — confirm
orderActionsPanel.conflictHint: Someone else has already changed this order. The buttons below now reflect the current state — there is no need to repeat the same action.
